name: @siftable/cli
description: Siftable CLI — human planning tasks, executable agent work queues, knowledge, and automation tools

scripts.prebuild: npm run build --workspace @siftable/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace @siftable/tabular-import
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist/lib/vendor',{recursive:true});for(const name of ['datasetQueryContract','leadDiscovery','leadDiscoveryCommandContract'])fs.copyFileSync('../shared/dist/types/'+name+'.js','dist/lib/vendor/'+name+'.js')"
scripts.interactive:dev: npm run manifest && (cd interactive-tui && bun run native:build) && SIFT_INTERACTIVE_RUNTIME=source node ./bin/run.js interactive
scripts.interactive:help: npm run build && npm run manifest && node ./bin/run.js interactive --help
scripts.package:interactive: npm run build --workspace @siftable/cli && bun install --cwd interactive-tui --frozen-lockfile && bun run interactive-tui/scripts/build-packaged-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:harness: cd interactive-tui && bun run pretest && bun test test/agentHarnessBoundary.test.ts test/agentHarnessWorkTools.test.ts test/compaction.test.ts test/packagedRuntime.test.ts && bun test test/agent-persistence.test.ts && bun test test/compact.test.ts && bun test test/rollout.test.ts
scripts.test:tui: cd interactive-tui && bun run pretest && bun test
scripts.test-coverage: npm run test:jest -- --coverage && npm run test:vitest -- --coverage.enabled
scripts.verify:harness: npm run typecheck:tui && vitest run test/commands/interactive.chat-agent.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts && npm run test:harness
scripts.verify:package: npm run package:interactive && npm run verify:harness && node scripts/verify-package-imports.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run manifest && npm run verify:package
